title: Ask HN: (Why) Was the LLM breakthrough useful for images, audio, etc.?
snippet: This has been bothering me for a while. I feel like I have a decent conceptual grasp of what LLMs are doing with written text. But it seems like they also unlocked a bunch of progress in understanding and generating images, audio, and video. I can’t twist my brain into understanding the connection.<
